headline: Mistral open-sources a trillion-parameter Large 4; guests say agentic attacks now cost cents per company

threads.title: Anthropic's IPO filing and the race to fund the frontier labs
threads.now: Anthropic filed its S-1 and could list on Nasdaq as soon as November, possibly raising about $100B at a $1.5T to $2T valuation. On All-In, hosts said it has raised about $110B, lost under $10B, holds about $100B in cash, and has 250 customers spending over $10M. Revenue figures differ by source. FT reportedly says OpenAI cut its round to about $20B.
threads.changed: On All-In, hosts said the S-1 shows Anthropic raised about $110B in total, lost only $9B to $10B, and holds roughly $100B in cash, so it may need to raise just $80B to $100B.
threads.watch: Anthropic's pricing and listing date in November; whether OpenAI or MGX confirm the reduced round; quarterly growth in its largest customers.

history.change: Anthropic S-1 digested on Hard Fork and Decoder; FT reportedly says OpenAI shrank its round to about $20B at $1.25T.
20VC adds Meta's reported equity raise and the scale of Anthropic's planned issuance.
All-In transcript: capital-efficiency reading of the S-1, a smaller needed raise, 250 customers above $10M, and open-source commoditization named as the top risk.

threads.title: AI capex boom meets a market selloff: cloud earnings, Vertiv and the chip rout
threads.now: Google Cloud revenue rose 103% to $30.7B; Microsoft Cloud hit $63.9B. Amazon says AWS grew over 39%. Alphabet says Gemini APIs process nearly 32 billion tokens a minute and holds 2026 capex at $195B to $205B. Thursday Intel fell 28.6% and the chip index about 7%.
threads.changed: On All-In, hosts said Alphabet shares fell 10% to 15% Thursday, erasing about $500B, on search ad-click worries, even as Google Cloud operating profit passed $11B versus $3.5B a year earlier.
threads.watch: Whether the chip and Alphabet selloff continues Monday and whether other PC or memory-exposed firms repeat Intel's warning.

evidence.label: Alphabet earnings call
evidence.quote: Moving to investments, our full-year 2026 CapEx guidance range of $195-$205 billion remain unchanged.

evidence.label: Amazon.com, Inc. (AMZN)
evidence.speaker: Andy Jassy, President and CEO, Amazon
evidence.quote: Our AWS investment in functionality and infrastructure is working, with over 39% year-over-year revenue growth in Q3 ($184 billion revenue run rate) and projected revenue growth rates of over 40% both in 2027 and in 2028

evidence.label: Vertiv Holdings Co (VRT)
evidence.speaker: Giordano Albertazzi, Vertiv's Chief Executive Officer
evidence.quote: We are in the middle of the largest infrastructure buildout and it's accelerating

history.change: Alphabet, Microsoft, Amazon and Vertiv report huge AI-driven growth; Thursday's chip rout and Amazon cash-flow worries cloud the picture.
Alphabet earnings call detail: capex guidance unchanged, free cash flow negative, outside compute capacity added.
All-In transcript: Google's earnings-day drop of about $500B in market value, cloud profit tripled, search revenue still up 12% per the hosts.

threads.title: AI-era security: stolen API keys, AI-built exploits and misalignment tests
threads.now: Wiz reportedly counts nine AI developer platforms breached in October for stored API keys, including Northflank. Epoch reportedly found open-weight GLM-5.3 built Firefox exploits for about $1,000 each. A security guest on The Cognitive Revolution said agentic attacks now cost cents per company. Cursor's marketplace carried a tampered Claude Code extension.
threads.changed: On The Cognitive Revolution, a security guest said agentic attacks in Southeast Asia over two weeks cost between five and ten cents to compromise a company, and new open cyber-specific models can be downloaded.
threads.watch: A Cursor post-mortem and install count; platform statements from Fireworks AI, Railway and Warp; bulk key revocations.

evidence.label: Cursor tampered extension ticket (@ishkme on X)
Epoch AI GLM-5.3 study via X

history.change: Wiz-reported wave of AI platform breaches, Epoch's GLM-5.3 Firefox exploit study and Anthropic's monitor-evasion data enter the board.
Tampered Claude Code extension found on Cursor's marketplace; Anthropic says its systems are unaffected.
Cognitive Revolution guest: agentic attacks cost five to ten cents per company; open cyber models proliferating.

threads.title: Google's Gemini 4 Carbon and the fight for the frontier
threads.now: Google announced Gemini 4 Carbon on Alphabet's earnings call. Relays put it first on Artificial Analysis v5.0 at 59 versus 58 for Claude Opus 5.5, and first on Mercor's APEX-Agents at 84.2% Pass@1. Access is gated to cyber defenders; no general availability, pricing or API date.
threads.changed: Mercor's APEX-Agents leaderboard puts Carbon first, ahead of Gemini 4 Argon and Claude Sonnet 5.5; Demis Hassabis shared it. Wider release is promised but undated.
threads.watch: A date for general availability, API pricing, and independent evals; any Anthropic or OpenAI response.

evidence.label: Alphabet earnings call
evidence.quote: And with Gemini 4 Argon and now Carbon, which we announced today, we're excited to be leading at the frontier.

history.change: Gemini 4 Carbon announced; tops Artificial Analysis v5 and APEX-Agents per relays; access still gated to cyber defenders.

threads.title: Mistral Large 4: a trillion-parameter open model and the open-versus-closed compute gap
threads.now: Mistral says it open-sourced Large 4, its largest open model: about one trillion parameters, sparse mixture of experts. On the Artificial Analysis coding subset it claims a tie with GLM 5.3 using half the tokens. Hosts said it trained on about 3,800 Blackwell GPUs, far below frontier clusters.
threads.changed: On The Cognitive Revolution, a Mistral researcher said Large 4 is its best agentic model and the best open model on coding, tied with GLM 5.3 at half the tokens. The claims are Mistral's own.
threads.watch: Independent evals of Large 4, its licence and hosting terms, and whether Western enterprises adopt it over Chinese open models.

history.change: Mistral Large 4 open release discussed on The Cognitive Revolution: one trillion parameters, claimed tie with GLM 5.3 on coding at half the tokens.

threads.title: Labs claim AI-made math and physics discoveries; experts hold back
threads.now: OpenAI announced three model-produced results, including a claimed disproof of the Exponential Time Hypothesis. Reviewers Impagliazzo, Paturi and Williams say in an open letter that their involvement is not certification. A similar Anthropic 3-SAT paper is reported only secondhand.
threads.changed: ETH reviewers said on the record they are not certifying OpenAI's claim; OpenAI reportedly agreed to release raw data and fund a conference.
threads.watch: An expert verdict on the ETH result, the KITP Yang-Mills group statement, and a first-party Anthropic post.

history.change: ETH disproof reviewers disclaim certification; verdict still pending.
